usedFor: SmartSurvey collects survey answers, and “New Response” starts work for each one while “Create Contact” stores people.

bestTemplate.name: “New Response” in SmartSurvey, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each answer becomes a lead, so follow-up starts with the response in hand.

watchOut: “New Response” is polling, so it is checked on a schedule and a response can arrive late.
